notes.title: Demo Release Update
notes.notes:
Updates?

It's been a long time coming and we are happy to share with you our official demo.
While the demo has been out for a week now for Gamescom, a few updates have been made to ensure a more stable and enjoyable run for our community.  

Simply visit our store page to access our demo here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1306010/BADA_Space_Station/

For the demo, region select is implemented and is encouraged when playing with one or more people! 
As for character and arena availability, 2 characters are available to play (Dr Scrap and Puppeteer) on the Mechanical Level. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38219030/69d5c4b3ae88b06e229d6754e84844c7a8e66218.png

Special access will be granted to testers, press, or streamers who would like to cover the game. This can be discussed with us via email (aika@terahard.org)!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38219030/c16393d497357519d22b229e58db9ae4a8432f4f.png

We continue to improve the game and fix bugs as they are reported so if there are any feedback you think is worth noting, do drop by our Discord and tell us about your experience! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38219030/829848634ca0a3d0d9af6140b1865d7dac5694b1.png
Our goal is to make a game that we can all enjoy.

We hope to meet you soon!

Cheers,
Terahard Team

notes.title: Development Update # 1 - Changes in Brute
notes.notes:
Greetings, spaceketeers! You are hearing us live from BADA Space Station!

It's been a long journey to where we are today and we certainly hit some snags along the way but the positive thing is we learn from it. Just recently we had a streaming event to gather some insights from real players in the community and because of their generous feedback, we have decided to enact some changes in our game. This being said, we have decided to discuss this in our first dev log!

notes.title: Alpha Livestream Event Begins Tomorrow + Localization Update!
notes.notes:
ALPHA LIVESTREAM EVENT

Tomorrow's the day!
Our Livestream event starts May 8 and ends on May 9, 2021!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38219030/ff82d931662d858e1c8204a58188568dab9ba553.png
Get the chance to see a peek of the earliest playable version of the game where the players can assemble your elite sales-force, and tear down wave after wave of alien monstrosities in order to push the products of their sponsors to the masses!

Find the official streamer list here: LIST

ALPHA FEATURES:

    1-4 Player Online and Local Co-op
    3 Awesome, Badass Characters
    3 Unique Arenas
    Customizable skills
    Tons of Replayability

LOCALIZED STEAM PAGE

We are happy to announce that our Steam page has been translated into 10 different languages!

LANGUAGE SUPPORT:

   Chinese
   Japanese
   Korean
   French
   Greek
   Italian
   Russian
   German
   Spanish
   Portuguese
  
With this, we hope this strengthens our growing community!
We hope to see you in our Alpha event!

Visit our Discord for updates: discord.gg/pcuSnwU8MB
